selection: Fixed workloads and seeds, no filtering by learned basis or answer success. Seeds shuffle training fact order/rename constants and perturb heldout graphs.
accounting: All arms pay the same data interpretation and up to two formation phases. Cold cache per batch/probe. Startup, checking, queries and serialization included; attached-checkpoint costs excluded. Model excludes answer rows; evidence/audit reported separately using Python canonical S-expression bytes. Measurement cores are nonpersistent views, not replay-valid saved sessions. No trained latent space or general speedup claim. Child RSS includes launch/startup.
